Game Overview

Shelter Security Gatekeeper Simulator puts players into a simulation experience centered on guard the gates of a peculiar post-apocalyptic shelter. Embrace chaos and humor while inspecting documents, scanning luggage, and discerning friend from foe in a world where prankster mutants and masked bandits test your vigilance. Can you handle the wild antics as the ultimate gatekeeper?
